explanation: Beckoning someone by curling your index finger palm-up is considered rude in Turkey, since it's associated with calling animals rather than people. The respectful way to call someone over is to extend your hand palm-down and make a scooping or scratching motion toward yourself.
local_tip: Use a palm-down scooping motion instead of a curling finger to call someone over.

also_check.note: Beckoning with the index finger is very rude and used only for animals or inferiors; use a full hand wave, palm down.
Beckoning with a finger is highly offensive; use a gentle hand motion with palm down instead.
Common among friends, but can seem aggressive or condescending in formal settings.
